evidence.text: Gridlumen is developing a predictive maintenance system for wind turbines that analyzes vibration data directly inside the turbine nacelle. We are currently in private beta.
Gridlumen was founded in 2024 by three engineers and raised a pre-seed round. We are running our first pilot with a wind-farm operator and expect to launch commercially next year.
